_comment: Sample manual wiring for the digital-twin pushback detector as a Claude Code PostToolUse hook. Prefer the installer: python3 skills/digital-twin/scripts/install-hook.py install (see commands/install-hook.md). Append the entry under 'hooks' to your settings file (default ~/.claude/settings.json), replacing ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with your plugin directory. Semantics match the installer: matcher '*', --hook-stdin, canonical --source/--state-file/--out-dir, no output redirection and no exit masking so detector errors stay visible on stderr.
_behavior_notes: PostToolUse can fire zero, one, or multiple times during an assistant turn, depending on successful matched tool uses — it does not run once per turn.
The detector reads only the transcript_path from the stdin hook payload and only new bytes since its last stored offset; prior sessions are never re-scanned.
Failure visibility: stdout/stderr are not redirected and the exit code is not masked, so detector errors appear in hook diagnostics instead of being silently swallowed.
The detector never writes to memory. It only queues proposals under the out-dir; each one requires explicit approval via /digital-twin:propose-rules.
